title: Why So Many Hospitals Are Suing Their Patients

sentences.en: For decades, hospitals could assume that patients with jobs and health insurance would pay their medical bills.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，医院一直认为有工作和医疗保险的患者会支付他们的医疗账单。

sentences.en: Sarah Clare on why that's no longer the case and the aggressive new way that hospitals are forcing those patients to pay up.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·克莱尔将为您讲述为何现在情况已不再如此，以及医院正在采取哪些激进的新手段强迫这些患者付款。

sentences.en: December 2nd.
It's been a while.
sentences.zh: 好久不见了。

sentences.en: It has been.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Sarah, tell me about Amanda Sturgill.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，跟我讲讲阿曼达·斯特吉尔的事吧。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: So Amanda is 41 years old.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达今年41岁。

sentences.en: She lives in this tiny little town in rural Virginia called Norton.
sentences.zh: 她住在弗吉尼亚州农村一个叫诺顿的小镇上。

sentences.en: It's very small.
sentences.zh: 那里非常小。

sentences.en: I don't even know why it's called a city because it's not very big.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道为什么它被称为城市，因为它一点也不大。

sentences.en: She has four children.
sentences.zh: 她有四个孩子。

sentences.en: She's a single mom.
sentences.zh: 她是一位单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: Sarah Cliff writes about healthcare for the Times.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·克利夫为《纽约时报》撰写医疗保健方面的报道。

sentences.en: She works full time at an audio equipment company where she processes orders.
sentences.zh: 她在一家音频设备公司全职工作，负责处理订单。

sentences.en: So it's just kind of like a little freak thing that happened.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一件偶然发生的怪事。

sentences.en: And a few years ago, I was working.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我当时正在工作。

sentences.en: Her daughter,
sentences.zh: 她的女儿，

sentences.en: Michaela, was giving one of the other kids a bath.
sentences.zh: 米凯拉，当时正在给其中一个孩子洗澡。

sentences.en: And she bent down to pick her up to get her out of the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 她弯下腰去抱她，想把她从浴缸里抱出来。

sentences.en: She bent down to pick up her sibling and just got this terrible pain in her back.
sentences.zh: 她弯腰去抱她的兄弟姐妹时，背部突然感到一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: Kind of go down her legs.
sentences.zh: 那种痛感似乎顺着她的腿蔓延开来。

sentences.en: And she was just in this horrible excruciating pain.
sentences.zh: 她当时正处于那种极其可怕的剧痛之中。

sentences.en: Took her to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 带她去了急诊室。

sentences.en: Amanda obviously is worried.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达显然很担心。

sentences.en: She doesn't understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 她不明白发生了什么事。

sentences.en: So she takes her daughter to the emergency room at the local hospital system, a company named Ballad.
sentences.zh: 于是她带着女儿去了当地医院系统的急诊室，那是一家叫 Ballad 的公司。

sentences.en: They give her a pain shot, go back home.
sentences.zh: 他们给她打了一针止痛药，然后就回家了。

sentences.en: But this pain doesn't go away.
sentences.zh: 但疼痛并没有消失。

sentences.en: I went back to the pediatrician.
sentences.zh: 我又回到了儿科医生那里。

sentences.en: It was probably weekly with Michaela to tell them this is not getting any better.
sentences.zh: 我大概每周都会带米凯拉去一次，告诉他们情况没有任何好转。

sentences.en: They start seeing specialists and doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们开始看专科医生和医生。

sentences.en: There are MRIs.
sentences.zh: 做了核磁共振检查。

sentences.en: There are more pain shots.
sentences.zh: 又打了更多的止痛针。

sentences.en: And no one can really figure out what's going on with Michaela.
sentences.zh: 没有人能真正弄清楚米凯拉到底出了什么问题。

sentences.en: And the pain is getting worse.
sentences.zh: 而且疼痛越来越严重。

sentences.en: She's just like, something's not right.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，有些地方不对劲。

sentences.en: I'm in really bad pain.
sentences.zh: 我疼得非常厉害。

sentences.en: She can't walk without pain.
sentences.zh: 她走路都疼。

sentences.en: She's having trouble sleeping.
sentences.zh: 她睡眠也出现了问题。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: Amanda's like, oh my gosh, is my teenage daughter going to have to live with this terrible pain for the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达心想，天哪，难道我十几岁的女儿余生都要带着这种可怕的疼痛生活吗？

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So it came back on the MRI.
sentences.zh: 核磁共振检查结果出来了。

sentences.en: There was a slight bulge down there.
sentences.zh: 下面有一个轻微的凸起。

sentences.en: They figure out that Michaela has a degenerative disc disease.
sentences.zh: 他们发现米凯拉患有退行性椎间盘疾病。

sentences.en: He's like, your daughter's back is the back of a 70-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 他说，你女儿的背部就像一个70岁老妇人的背。

sentences.en: So it's serious.
sentences.zh: 所以情况很严重。

sentences.en: And a doctor recommends that the best course of action is surgery.
sentences.zh: 医生建议最好的治疗方案是手术。

sentences.en: When you found out Michaela needed surgery, kind of what was going through your mind.
sentences.zh: 当你发现米凯拉需要手术时，你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: Oh, I was terrified.
sentences.zh: 哦，我吓坏了。

sentences.en: Terrified of thinking your young child is going to have to go through this excruciating surgery.
sentences.zh: 一想到你年幼的孩子要经历这种痛苦的手术，就感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And were you worried about money at all when you found out about the surgery?
sentences.zh: 当你得知手术的消息时，你担心过钱的问题吗？

sentences.en: No, I honestly, I didn't care.
sentences.zh: 没有，老实说，我不在乎。

sentences.en: I was like, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不在乎。

sentences.en: You run whatever test you run.
sentences.zh: 你们要做什么检查就做吧。

sentences.en: I will deal with the bills when they come.
sentences.zh: 账单来了我会处理的。

sentences.en: I was like, just, you know, help her get her better.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，只要能帮她好起来就行。

sentences.en: So the surgery happens.
sentences.zh: 于是手术进行了。

sentences.en: It goes decently well.
sentences.zh: 手术还算顺利。

sentences.en: It doesn't fully relieve Michaela's pain.
sentences.zh: 但并没有完全缓解米凯拉的疼痛。

sentences.en: So that issue still lingers.
sentences.zh: 所以这个问题依然存在。

sentences.en: But they go home and then the bills start showing up.
sentences.zh: 但他们回家后，账单就开始寄来了。

sentences.en: It was just one of those days where, you know, just go check the mail, go walk out to the end of the road.
sentences.zh: 那天就是那种日子，你知道，去查查邮件，走到路尽头去看看。

sentences.en: And we get a couple bills that were about 200 here and there.
sentences.zh: 我们收到几张账单，大概是200美元左右。

sentences.en: They trickle in because remember, there have been all these doctor appointments, all these specialists and MRIs and shots.
sentences.zh: 它们陆陆续续地寄来，因为别忘了，之前还有所有的医生预约、所有的专科医生、核磁共振和打针。

sentences.en: So there's a few that are like
sentences.zh: 所以有几张是

sentences.en: 50 something.
sentences.zh: 50多美元。

sentences.en: 100 there.
200 here.
But then the bills get bigger.
sentences.zh: 但后来账单金额越来越大。

sentences.en: Ended up owing like 500 and some dollars per MRI.
sentences.zh: 最后每次核磁共振都要欠500多美元。

sentences.en: And then the surgeon.
sentences.zh: 然后是外科医生。

sentences.en: The surgery bill comes and that's over $2,000.
sentences.zh: 手术账单来了，超过了2000美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦，哇。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting that.
sentences.zh: 我没预料到会这样。

sentences.en: For Amanda, you know, she earns $12 and 70 cents per hour at her job.
sentences.zh: 对于阿曼达来说，你知道，她每小时的工资是12.70美元。

sentences.en: This is a really significant bill.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔非常沉重的账单。

sentences.en: And she just does not have the money to pay it.
sentences.zh: 她根本没有钱支付。

sentences.en: And does Amanda have insurance?
sentences.zh: 阿曼达有保险吗？

sentences.en: She does.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She has insurance at work.
sentences.zh: 她在工作单位有保险。

sentences.en: She felt like it was good insurance.
sentences.zh: 她觉得那是份不错的保险。

sentences.en: But then she's finding that her insurance actually expects her to pay a lot of co-pays, a certain share of the surgery.
sentences.zh: 但后来她发现，保险公司实际上要求她支付大量的共付额，以及手术费用中她应承担的那部分。

sentences.en: And it's starting to get pretty stressful.
sentences.zh: 这开始让她感到压力很大。

sentences.en: It's like, well, let's just start from what we can and what we can't do.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，让我们从能做和不能做的事情开始梳理吧。

sentences.en: So I just started filling some out and sending them.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始填一些表格并寄出去。

sentences.en: But there's so many.
sentences.zh: 但账单实在太多了。

sentences.en: She really wants to pay the bills.
sentences.zh: 她真的很想付清账单。

sentences.en: I pretty much clinch every penny I possibly can.
sentences.zh: 我几乎把每一分钱都攥得紧紧的。

sentences.en: And what is going through your mind about these bills as they're piling up?
sentences.zh: 当这些账单堆积如山时，你心里在想什么？

sentences.en: I will go to flea markets, have yard sales, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 我会去跳蚤市场，举办庭院拍卖会之类的活动。

sentences.en: She's trying to scrape together the money.
sentences.zh: 她正在努力凑钱。

sentences.en: I will sometimes not eat, but like once a day to try to save money so I don't have to buy food and just save it all for them.
sentences.zh: 我有时一天只吃一顿饭，为了省钱，这样我就不用买食物，把钱都留给他们。

sentences.en: We'll have dinner together.
sentences.zh: 我们会一起吃晚饭。

sentences.en: And they see me do that, but they have no idea that I do that during the day.
sentences.zh: 他们看到我那样吃，但他们根本不知道我白天其实没吃东西。

sentences.en: But then during the entire day, you don't eat to save money.
sentences.zh: 但你白天整天都不吃东西来省钱？

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，是的。

sentences.en: How do you feel by the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 一天结束时你感觉如何？

sentences.en: I know you work a full-time job.
sentences.zh: 我知道你有一份全职工作。

sentences.en: I get pretty emotional sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有时会变得很情绪化。

sentences.en: You know, I'll go and cry and hide in the bathroom and then just, you know, come out and be the happy mom that I need to be to make sure that their life is as normal as possible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会去洗手间躲起来哭，然后出来，做回我必须做的那个快乐妈妈，确保他们的生活尽可能正常。

sentences.en: I don't let them know any of this.
sentences.zh: 我没让他们知道这些。

sentences.en: So for a while this works and she's able to keep up with the bills, she's sending in payments to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以有一段时间这很有效，她能够跟上账单的支付进度，她一直在向医院汇款。

sentences.en: But a few months ago, she falls behind.
sentences.zh: 但几个月前，她开始拖欠了。

sentences.en: She just isn't able to come up with the payments that she's supposed to be making on these bills.
sentences.zh: 她实在无法支付这些账单上要求的金额。

sentences.en: And then one day there's a knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，有人敲门。

sentences.en: It was about midday.
sentences.zh: 那是中午左右。

sentences.en: The kids were home.
sentences.zh: 孩子们都在家。

sentences.en: And the dogs start barking.
sentences.zh: 狗开始叫起来。

sentences.en: And the kids were like, mom, there's a cough on our porch.
sentences.zh: 孩子们说，妈妈，门廊上有个警察。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, OK, someone out there.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦，好的，外面有人。

sentences.en: He was in his brown sheriff's uniform.
sentences.zh: 他穿着棕色的警长制服。

sentences.en: He had his sheriff car that had the lights and the sheriff stickers all over it.
sentences.zh: 他开着警长车，上面有警灯和警长的标志。

sentences.en: And he has a document that he needs to give Amanda.
sentences.zh: 他有一份文件需要交给阿曼达。

sentences.en: You know, we've got this summons to court.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们收到了法院传票。

sentences.en: And I was like, wow, OK.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哇，好吧。

sentences.en: So Amanda takes the documents.
sentences.zh: 于是阿曼达接过了文件。

sentences.en: You know, I just I said, thanks for bringing it to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是说，谢谢你把它送来。

sentences.en: So I ended up having to.
sentences.zh: 所以我最后不得不。

sentences.en: She tells the kids, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 她告诉孩子们，别担心。

sentences.en: It's just some important papers that they couldn't deliver in the mail.
sentences.zh: 这只是一些无法通过邮件投递的重要文件。

sentences.en: You know, just so they wouldn't like freak out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，只是为了让他们不至于惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Then she actually opens it up.
sentences.zh: 然后她真的打开了它。

sentences.en: And it turns out that the hospital is suing her for the medical debt that she owes them.
sentences.zh: 结果发现医院因为她欠他们的医疗债务而起诉了她。

sentences.en: And this is a court warrant with a court date that they're asking her to attend.
sentences.zh: 这是一份带有出庭日期的法院传票，要求她出席。

sentences.en: I was very shocked and scared because then I'm just like, oh, my gosh, I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常震惊和害怕，因为我心想，天哪，我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: So she has fallen behind on this bill and the hospital is now taking her to court over this unpaid bill.
sentences.zh: 所以她拖欠了这笔账单，医院现在正因为这笔未付账单将她告上法庭。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And things have moved from the billing department into the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 事情已经从账单部门转移到了法庭上。

sentences.en: Amanda has a court date.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达有了出庭日期。

sentences.en: June the 27th.
But it turns out her court date is actually a day she has an appointment.
sentences.zh: 但结果发现，她出庭的那天正好是她有预约的日子。

sentences.en: I had to go to get checked because I had a lump in my breaSt. So we had to go and get that checked out.
sentences.zh: 我当时必须去检查，因为我乳房里有个肿块。所以我们必须去把它检查清楚。

sentences.en: And I wasn't missing that for nothing because it took me.
sentences.zh: 我绝不能错过这次检查，因为这对我来说很重要。

sentences.en: She had recently found a lump in her breast and it had taken her weeks to schedule a mammogram.
sentences.zh: 她最近发现乳房里有个肿块，花了几个星期才预约到乳房X光检查。

sentences.en: And where did you have that doctor's appointment?
sentences.zh: 那你是在哪里做的医生预约？

sentences.en: It was in Ballad.
sentences.zh: 是在Ballad。

sentences.en: It's one of their physicians.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的一位医生。

sentences.en: And how did that turn out?
sentences.zh: 结果怎么样？

sentences.en: Is everything okay with the lump that they found?
sentences.zh: 他们发现的那个肿块没问题吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Glad to hear that.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听到这个消息。

sentences.en: It was just a benign little tumor thing.
sentences.zh: 那只是个良性的小肿瘤之类的东西。

sentences.en: So, but yeah, it's good.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这很好。

sentences.en: So you were going to get health care from the same provider that was suing you over your medical bills on the same day?
sentences.zh: 所以你是在同一天，去同一家因为医疗账单起诉你的医疗机构看病？

sentences.en: Yeah, because we have nothing else.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我们别无选择。

sentences.en: We have no other options.
sentences.zh: 我们没有其他选择。

sentences.en: You know, it really makes you feel uncomfortable because it's like when you go, it's like, do they know that, you know, Ballad is suing me over this?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的让人感到很不舒服，因为当你去的时候，你会想，他们知道Ballad因为这件事在起诉我吗？

sentences.en: Are they going to say something to me?
sentences.zh: 他们会对我说什么吗？

sentences.en: Are they going to deny me health care because I owe them money?
sentences.zh: 他们会因为我欠他们钱而拒绝为我提供医疗服务吗？

sentences.en: It was pretty terrifying.
sentences.zh: 这真的很可怕。

sentences.en: Sarah, nothing about this sounds normal.
sentences.zh: Sarah，这听起来一点也不正常。

sentences.en: A mother with a solid job and health insurance suddenly has a sheriff at her door and she faces legal action over falling behind on a medical bill.
sentences.zh: 一位有稳定工作和医疗保险的母亲，突然有警长敲门，还因为拖欠医疗账单面临法律诉讼。

sentences.en: It is actually becoming surprisingly common in our health care system.
sentences.zh: 这在我们的医疗体系中正变得越来越普遍。

sentences.en: There are thousands of
sentences.zh: 有成千上万的

sentences.en: Americans, many with private insurance, currently being sued by their hospitals.
sentences.zh: 美国人，其中许多人有私人保险，目前正被他们的医院起诉。

sentences.en: They're in big cities, they're in small towns.
sentences.zh: 他们在大城市，也在小城镇。

sentences.en: And the reason I know this is actually the story of how I found Amanda.
sentences.zh: 我之所以知道这一点，其实就是我发现Amanda的故事。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请下载

sentences.en: Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 《时报》应用程序，今天就获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, Sarah, you said that finding Amanda helped you understand how widespread this problem was.
sentences.zh: 好的，Sarah，你说找到Amanda让你了解了这个问题有多普遍。

sentences.en: So how did you find Amanda?
sentences.zh: 那么你是怎么找到Amanda的？

sentences.en: I found Amanda a few months ago when I went to this tiny little courtroom in rural Virginia, about six hours west of Washington, D.C., where I live.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我去弗吉尼亚州农村的一个小法庭时发现了Amanda，那里离我住的华盛顿特区大约有六个小时的车程。

sentences.en: And on the day I went to court, there were
sentences.zh: 在我去法庭的那天，有

sentences.en: 160 cases on the docket.
sentences.zh: 160起案件在排期表上。

sentences.en: 102 of those cases were being brought by the local hospital system,
sentences.zh: 其中102起案件是由当地的医院系统提起的，

sentences.en: Ballad.
sentences.zh: Ballad。

sentences.en: In each of those cases, the hospital was suing one of its patients for outstanding medical death.
sentences.zh: 在每一起案件中，医院都在起诉其患者，要求偿还未付的医疗债务。

sentences.en: And Amanda was one of the 102 cases that would be hurt that day.
sentences.zh: 而Amanda就是那天要审理的102起案件之一。

sentences.en: So what's happening here?
sentences.zh: 那么这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why is the local hospital suing over 100 of its patients?
sentences.zh: 为什么当地医院要起诉100多名患者？

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's something I started to figure out talking to the people who are in the courtroom and calling people who weren't in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是我通过与法庭里的人交谈，并给那些没在法庭的人打电话开始弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: It turns out most patients actually didn't show up to their court date.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，大多数患者实际上并没有出现在他们的出庭日期。

sentences.en: And what I found out is a lot of these people had health insurance.
sentences.zh: 我发现很多人其实是有医疗保险的。

sentences.en: There was a school teacher, a correctional officer, even a woman who worked at the hospital who had private
sentences.zh: 有一位学校老师、一名惩教人员，甚至还有一位在医院工作的女性，她们都有私人

sentences.en: insurance but were responsible for shares of their bills that they just felt like they couldn't pay.
sentences.zh: 保险，但她们需要承担自己觉得无法支付的那部分账单。

sentences.en: And now Ballad was turning to the courts to recoup the money that they were owed.
sentences.zh: 现在Ballad正诉诸法庭来追回他们被拖欠的钱。

sentences.en: Why is that the case?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why are people with jobs and insurance falling behind on their payments and now being sued?
sentences.zh: 为什么有工作和保险的人会拖欠付款，现在还被起诉？

sentences.en: So in order to understand that, I think you need to zoom out from the courtroom and look at a big
sentences.zh: 为了理解这一点，我认为你需要从法庭的角度跳出来，看看过去十年左右我们的医疗体系中发生的一个巨大

sentences.en: change that has been happening in our health care system over the past decade or so.
sentences.zh: 变化。

sentences.en: What I see in my reporting is patients consistently being asked to spend more and more of their own money on health care even when they have insurance.
sentences.zh: 我在报道中看到，即使患者有保险，他们也被持续要求在医疗保健上花费越来越多的个人资金。

sentences.en: A really perfect example of this is deductibles.
sentences.zh: 一个非常典型的例子就是免赔额。

sentences.en: That's the amount that a patient has to pay before their insurance will start kicking in and covering their doctor visits in their hospital trips.
sentences.zh: 这是患者在保险开始介入并支付医生就诊和住院费用之前必须支付的金额。

sentences.en: If you look back to like 2006 or so, only about half of people who had insurance even had a deductible.
sentences.zh: 如果你回顾2006年左右，只有大约一半有保险的人有免赔额。

sentences.en: They weren't that common.
sentences.zh: 它们并不常见。

sentences.en: You flash forward to this year and 82% of people who get insurance at work now have a deductible.
sentences.zh: 快进到今年，82%通过工作获得保险的人现在都有免赔额。

sentences.en: The size of the average deductible has about tripled between 2006 and 2018.
sentences.zh: 平均免赔额的大小在2006年到2018年间大约翻了三倍。

sentences.en: Used to be about $600.
sentences.zh: 过去大约是600美元。

sentences.en: Now it's about $1,700.
sentences.zh: 现在大约是1700美元。

sentences.en: So you have this moment when health care prices are going up and up and up and patients are being asked to pay for it and pay more through deductibles, through co-payments.
sentences.zh: 所以你正处于这样一个时刻：医疗价格不断上涨，患者被要求通过免赔额、共同支付来支付这些费用，而且支付得更多。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why are so many of these plans now asking people to pay such a high deductible?
sentences.zh: 为什么现在这么多计划要求人们支付如此高的免赔额？

sentences.en: It mostly comes down to the fact that health care prices are growing really quickly.
sentences.zh: 这主要归结于医疗价格增长非常快的事实。

sentences.en: And if you're an employer, if you're an HR department, you have a few ways to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 如果你是雇主，如果你是人力资源部门，你有几种方法来处理这个问题。

sentences.en: You could increase your employees' premiuMs. That's the amount they pay each month.
sentences.zh: 你可以增加员工的保费。也就是他们每个月支付的金额。

sentences.en: Or you could keep premiums constant and just ask people to pay more when they go to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以保持保费不变，只是要求人们在看医生时支付更多费用。

sentences.en: A lot of companies have found that the latter option is the way they want to go.
sentences.zh: 许多公司发现后一种选择是他们想要采取的方式。

sentences.en: So that's how employers deal with this problem of rising costs.
sentences.zh: 这就是雇主处理成本上升问题的方式。

sentences.en: But then you have someone like Amanda, who does have to go to the doctor a lot for her daughter and ends up with this bill she can't afford.
sentences.zh: 但你也有像Amanda这样的人，她确实因为女儿不得不经常去看医生，结果背负了她负担不起的账单。

sentences.en: And you have the hospital on the other end of this, who is watching hundreds of Amandas in their system, all of a sudden not being
sentences.zh: 而医院处于这一端的另一面，他们看着系统里成百上千个像Amanda这样的人，突然无法

sentences.en: able to pay the bills that the insurance company typically was taking care of.
sentences.zh: 支付保险公司通常会承担的账单。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And when a person can't pay that bill, now the hospital is suddenly on the hook.
sentences.zh: 当一个人付不起账单时，现在医院突然就陷入了困境。

sentences.en: So it's like cascading through the system.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像在系统中产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And hospital executives, when they see someone who comes in with insurance, they're thinking, okay, this is someone who could pay their bills.
sentences.zh: 医院高管在看到有保险的人进来时，他们会想，好吧，这是一个能支付账单的人。

sentences.en: They have the backing of an insurance company.
sentences.zh: 他们有保险公司的支持。

sentences.en: But that's not really the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You have this whole new bucket of patients that hospital executives aren't really sure how to deal with.
sentences.zh: 你有一大批新的患者，医院高管并不确定该如何处理。

sentences.en: Some are dealing with it by coming up with financial assistance for those people.
sentences.zh: 有些人通过为这些人提供经济援助来处理。

sentences.en: Others are dealing with it by going to court to try and collect the debt that insurance companies used to pay them.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则通过诉诸法庭，试图收回保险公司过去支付给他们的债务。

sentences.en: So what do hospitals like Ballad say about why they're making this decision to sue their patients?
sentences.zh: 那么像Ballad这样的医院对于为什么决定起诉患者是怎么说的？

sentences.en: They say that, look, we're a business.
sentences.zh: 他们说，看，我们是一家企业。

sentences.en: We have to stay open.
sentences.zh: 我们必须保持营业。

sentences.en: We have to stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 我们必须维持运营。

sentences.en: Ballad exists in a pretty rural area, part of Virginia and Tennessee.
sentences.zh: Ballad存在于一个相当偏远的地区，涵盖弗吉尼亚州和田纳西州的部分地区。

sentences.en: And we've seen a lot of rural hospitals closing.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到很多农村医院倒闭了。

sentences.en: They would argue that the financially responsible thing to do is collect the debts that are owed to them.
sentences.zh: 他们会辩称，财务上负责任的做法是收回欠他们的债务。

sentences.en: They say that they only pursue patients in court who can afford to pay but have chosen not to pay their medical bills.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们只在法庭上起诉那些有能力支付却选择不支付医疗账单的患者。

sentences.en: So people who, in their minds, if they prioritized paying back these bills and organized their finances around that, they could pay those bills.
sentences.zh: 也就是在他们看来，如果这些人优先考虑偿还这些账单并围绕这一点安排财务，他们本可以支付这些账单的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, these are people with jobs, people with insurance.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些人有工作，有保险。

sentences.en: From their perspective, these are people who could pay that debt.
sentences.zh: 从他们的角度来看，这些人是有能力偿还债务的。

sentences.en: And Ballad is serious about collecting that debt.
sentences.zh: 而且Ballad在追讨债务方面是认真的。

sentences.en: I just feel sometimes like I'm failing my kids, even though I know I'm doing the best that I can for them.
sentences.zh: 我有时只是觉得我辜负了我的孩子们，尽管我知道我已经尽我所能为他们做了。

sentences.en: And what does someone like Amanda say to that?
sentences.zh: 那么像Amanda这样的人对此怎么说？

sentences.en: I know you're making about $13 an hour.
sentences.zh: 我知道你每小时大约赚13美元。

sentences.en: You're supporting four kids.
sentences.zh: 你要抚养四个孩子。

sentences.en: How do you think you got tagged as someone who should be able to make their payments?
sentences.zh: 你认为你是怎么被贴上“应该有能力支付账单”的人的标签的？

sentences.en: I honestly have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: She does not think she fits that description.
sentences.zh: 她认为自己并不符合那种描述。

sentences.en: How in the world do you all think that I can pay this off?
sentences.zh: 你们到底是怎么认为我能还清这笔钱的？

sentences.en: It's like my paycheck every couple of weeks is, I think I clear $806.
sentences.zh: 就像我每两周的工资，我想我到手是806美元。

sentences.en: Amanda feels like she's skipping meals and she's selling her things to pay.
sentences.zh: Amanda觉得她为了付账单在省吃俭用，还在变卖她的东西。

sentences.en: You know, my mortgage and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的抵押贷款之类的东西。

sentences.en: And there's kids to take care of.
sentences.zh: 还有孩子要照顾。

sentences.en: It's like I've not paid my water bill yet.
sentences.zh: 就像我还没付水费一样。

sentences.en: I just keep thinking, please don't come turn it off right now.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，请现在不要来把它停掉。

sentences.en: That sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: And then I've got a payment arrangement with the electric because I got a disconnect notice.
sentences.zh: 然后我和电力公司有一个付款安排，因为我收到了断电通知。

sentences.en: So you've been putting off your electric and water to pay the health bills?
sentences.zh: 所以你一直在推迟支付电费和水费来支付医疗账单？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because I don't want to, you know, be took to jail if that's what they would do or whatever.
sentences.zh: 因为我不想，你知道，如果他们会那样做的话，被带去坐牢或者其他什么。

sentences.en: You've said that this is becoming more common, but just how common is this kind of a lawsuit now?
sentences.zh: 你说这种情况正变得越来越普遍，但这种诉讼现在到底有多普遍？

sentences.en: So what's happening at Ballad is pretty representative of a trend we're seeing across the country.
sentences.zh: Ballad发生的事情非常能代表我们在全国范围内看到的趋势。

sentences.en: If you look at Ballad's lawsuit volume, they've been suing patients for a while.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看Ballad的诉讼量，他们起诉患者已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: But back in 2010, it was about 3,600 lawsuits a year in the court records I examined.
sentences.zh: 但在2010年，在我查阅的法庭记录中，每年大约有3600起诉讼。

sentences.en: Flash forward 2018, there's over 6,700 lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 快进到2018年，有超过6700起诉讼。

sentences.en: So double.
sentences.zh: 所以翻了一倍。

sentences.en: Doubled in less than a decade.
sentences.zh: 在不到十年内翻了一番。

sentences.en: You look at other hospitals.
sentences.zh: 你看看其他医院。

sentences.en: Children's in Wisconsin is a good example.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州的儿童医院就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: This is a nonprofit pediatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 这是一家非营利性儿科医院。

sentences.en: They've sued more than 1,000 patients since the start of 2018.
sentences.zh: 自2018年初以来，他们已经起诉了超过1000名患者。

sentences.en: And that's more lawsuits in two years than the entire decade prior.
sentences.zh: 这比之前整个十年的诉讼总数还要多。

sentences.en: Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, New York Presbyterian in Manhattan, they still have pretty low lawsuit volume, but it's going up.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩的约翰霍普金斯大学，曼哈顿的纽约长老会医院，他们的诉讼量仍然很低，但正在上升。

sentences.en: And is it ever the case that a company like Ballad sues a patient, the patient pays, and it all resolves itself?
sentences.zh: 像Ballad这样的公司起诉患者，患者支付，然后一切都解决了，这种情况发生过吗？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: So hospitals are finding that the courts are a pretty good way to collect money for a few reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以医院发现法庭是收钱的好方法，原因有几个。

sentences.en: The first is that patients typically don't show up to their court date.
sentences.zh: 首先是患者通常不会出现在他们的出庭日期。

sentences.en: That means as long as the hospital sends a lawyer, they're going to win the case because the other party didn't show up.
sentences.zh: 这意味着只要医院派一名律师，他们就会赢得官司，因为对方没有出庭。

sentences.en: Once the hospital wins the case, they have the rights to start garnishing their patients' wages.
sentences.zh: 一旦医院赢了官司，他们就有权开始扣押患者的工资。

sentences.en: You can get a lien on their property.
sentences.zh: 你可以对他们的财产进行留置权。

sentences.en: You could even arrest them.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以逮捕他们。

sentences.en: It gives the hospital a lot of power working through the court system.
sentences.zh: 这给了医院通过司法系统运作的很大权力。

sentences.en: So how does Amanda's case end up playing out in court?
sentences.zh: 那么Amanda的案子在法庭上最终是如何发展的？

sentences.en: So she doesn't go to the first court date.
sentences.zh: 所以她没有去第一次出庭日期。

sentences.en: I had previously contacted them to let them know that I wasn't going to be there.
sentences.zh: 我之前联系过他们，让他们知道我不会去那里。

sentences.en: There's a second court date that she said she never heard about where the hospital does get judgment against her.
sentences.zh: 她说她从未听说过有第二次开庭，但医院确实在那次庭审中获得了对她的判决。

sentences.en: But her wages have not been garnished.
sentences.zh: 但她的工资并没有被扣押。

sentences.en: She ended up setting up $150 a month payment plan.
sentences.zh: 她最终制定了一个每月还款150美元的计划。

sentences.en: And have you been able to make the payment each month?
sentences.zh: 你每个月都能按时还款吗？

sentences.en: Um, I have up until this past month.
sentences.zh: 嗯，直到上个月之前我都能做到。

sentences.en: I was really trying to.
sentences.zh: 我真的很努力了。

sentences.en: It's just hard.
sentences.zh: 只是太难了。

sentences.en: Every time my phone would ring, I'd say, please don't be valid to call on me.
sentences.zh: 每次电话一响，我就想，求求你别是来找我催债的。

sentences.en: Please don't be valid.
sentences.zh: 求求你别是。

sentences.en: So what happens once she starts falling behind in these payments?
sentences.zh: 那么，当她开始拖欠这些款项时会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: So she's nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以她很紧张。

sentences.en: She's worried, you know, there's this court warrant out for me.
sentences.zh: 她很担心，你知道，心想‘法院对我发出了传票’。

sentences.en: Could they throw me in jail?
sentences.zh: 他们会把我关进监狱吗？

sentences.en: And she sees that the hospital is calling her.
sentences.zh: 而且她看到医院在给她打电话。

sentences.en: I was terrified to answer it because I hadn't made the payment.
sentences.zh: 我当时害怕接听，因为我没能按时还款。

sentences.en: I was scared to death.
sentences.zh: 我吓坏了。

sentences.en: So I let it go to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 所以我让电话转到了语音信箱。

sentences.en: But then I called her back and I was like, hey, it's Amanda.
sentences.zh: 但后来我回拨了过去，我说，嘿，我是阿曼达。

sentences.en: What do you need?
sentences.zh: 你们找我有什么事？

sentences.en: And the person on the other end of the phone says, we're just calling to tell you.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的人说，我们打电话只是想告诉你。

sentences.en: We had an anonymous donor that paid off your warrant, which was, I think, like $2,200 is what it was final down to.
sentences.zh: 有一位匿名捐赠者替你还清了传票上的欠款，我想最终金额大概是2200美元左右。

sentences.en: Somebody paid your medical bill.
sentences.zh: 有人替你付清了医疗账单。

sentences.en: You don't have to make payments anymore.
sentences.zh: 你不需要再还款了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 啊？

sentences.en: I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了。

sentences.en: I said, are you sure?
sentences.zh: 我说，你确定吗？

sentences.en: You know, can you just recheck?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你能再核实一下吗？

sentences.en: And she goes, no.
sentences.zh: 她说，不用。

sentences.en: She said, it is.
sentences.zh: 她说，确实如此。

sentences.en: She said, we are writing it.
sentences.zh: 她说，我们正在处理。

sentences.en: We're doing all this stuff to get it taken care of.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做所有必要的事情来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And it's paid off.
sentences.zh: 账单已经付清了。

sentences.en: And it was such a relief.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种解脱。

sentences.en: And I was like, you can't tell me who did it so I can thank them.
sentences.zh: 我说，你不能告诉我那是谁吗？这样我好谢谢他们。

sentences.en: And she's like, no.
sentences.zh: 她说，不行。

sentences.en: I was like, well.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: So what had happened here?
sentences.zh: 那么这里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what happened was I ended up writing about Amanda's story in the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，我最终在《纽约时报》上写了关于阿曼达的故事。

sentences.en: And between that story running and that phone call, an anonymous donor read about the story, called Ballad and offered to pay off Amanda's bills.
sentences.zh: 在那篇报道发表和那通电话之间，一位匿名捐赠者读到了这个故事，打电话给Ballad医院，主动提出要替阿曼达付清账单。

sentences.en: So she is now without debt from this back problem that her daughter had.
sentences.zh: 所以她现在已经没有了因为她女儿背部问题而产生的债务。

sentences.en: She's kind of scot-free.
sentences.zh: 她算是彻底解脱了。

sentences.en: Well, sort of.
sentences.zh: 嗯，算是吧。

sentences.en: So how much do you still owe to Ballad right now?
sentences.zh: 那么你现在还欠Ballad医院多少钱？

sentences.en: Um, shoot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，天哪。

sentences.en: I've got Apollo bills.
sentences.zh: 我还有其他账单。

sentences.en: It's about $5,400 and some dollars.
sentences.zh: 大约还有5400多美元。

sentences.en: Then I know I'm paying on another one, which is like $1,000.
sentences.zh: 然后我知道我还在还另一笔账单，大约1000美元。

sentences.en: My ex has a couple that he's paying on that I just, I could not do.
sentences.zh: 我的前夫也在还几笔账，我实在无能为力。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I mean, it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，这笔钱很多。

sentences.en: It's a lot.
sentences.zh: 真的很多。

sentences.en: Sarah, what do you make of what happened to Amanda?
sentences.zh: 莎拉，你对阿曼达的遭遇怎么看？

sentences.en: I think it shows you something really problematic about the current state of American health insurance.
sentences.zh: 我认为这揭示了美国医疗保险现状中非常成问题的一点。

sentences.en: When you think of even the concept of insurance, it's supposed to mean protection.
sentences.zh: 当你想到保险这个概念时，它本应意味着保障。

sentences.en: It's supposed to mean you have someone else who's going to pay your medical bills no matter how high they get.
sentences.zh: 它本应意味着无论医疗账单有多高，都有人替你支付。

sentences.en: We spend a lot of time talking about the people who don't have a health insurance, about 30 million or so Americans at this point.
sentences.zh: 我们花了很多时间讨论那些没有医疗保险的人，目前大约有3000万美国人。

sentences.en: But you also have this class of people who you could think of as underinsured, who are paying premiums, who are buying some kind of product that they think of as insurance.
sentences.zh: 但还有一类人，你可以称之为“保险不足”的人，他们支付保费，购买某种他们认为是保险的产品。

sentences.en: But then when they actually have to use a lot of health care, they're finding that it's not really protecting them in the way that they expected to be protected.
sentences.zh: 但当他们真正需要大量医疗服务时，却发现它并没有像他们预期的那样保护他们。

sentences.en: It's not like I'm out here trying to live this lavish life and I'm just wanting to forget these doctor bills.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我在外面过着奢华的生活，只是想赖掉这些医生账单。

sentences.en: You know, I don't need to pay them through a hospital.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我并不想通过医院来支付它们。

sentences.en: It's not that.
sentences.zh: 不是那样的。

sentences.en: I don't have the means to pay it.
sentences.zh: 我只是没有能力支付。

sentences.en: What else could I have done?
sentences.zh: 我还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: What else could I have done different?
sentences.zh: 我还能做些什么不同的事情吗？

sentences.en: Let's say you were in charge of health insurance in the United States.
sentences.zh: 假设你负责美国的医疗保险。

sentences.en: How do you think it should work for someone like you?
sentences.zh: 你认为对于像你这样的人来说，它应该如何运作？

sentences.en: Oh, goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I've thought about this so many times and it's so weird that you asked me this.
sentences.zh: 我思考过这个问题很多次，你问我这个问题真是太巧了。

sentences.en: I just feel like we're the United States.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我们是美国。

sentences.en: We should come together and take care of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们应该团结起来，互相照顾。

sentences.en: I would love to see people be healthier and just not have to worry.
sentences.zh: 我希望能看到人们更健康，不必担心这些。

sentences.en: Everybody can go to the doctor without being afraid to go.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能去看医生，而不必因为害怕而不敢去。

sentences.en: Okay, Siri, right now we're in the middle of a national debate about those very questions, the future of American health care.
sentences.zh: 好的，莎拉，现在我们正处于一场关于这些问题的全国性辩论中，即美国医疗保健的未来。

sentences.en: And the concept that is most widely debated in the context of the presidential election is Medicare for all,
sentences.zh: 在总统选举背景下，讨论最广泛的概念是“全民医保”，

sentences.en: is the United States government taking on health care and eliminating the kind of private insurance that someone like Amanda has.
sentences.zh: 即由美国政府承担医疗保健，并取消像阿曼达所拥有的那种私人保险。

sentences.en: If such a system were created, how would it address the issues that you have discovered in your reporting?
sentences.zh: 如果建立了这样一个系统，它将如何解决你在报道中发现的问题？

sentences.en: The system being proposed now in the presidential primary would get rid of deductibles.
sentences.zh: 目前在总统初选中提出的方案将取消免赔额。

sentences.en: There'd be no premiuMs.
sentences.zh: 将不再有保费。

sentences.en: There'd be no copayments.
sentences.zh: 将不再有共同支付。

sentences.en: When you went to the doctor, you would not pay a single penny.
sentences.zh: 当你去看医生时，你一分钱都不用付。

sentences.en: But the money has to come from somewhere, right?
sentences.zh: 但钱总得从某个地方来，对吧？

sentences.en: You need a lot of those anonymous donors who paid off Amanda's bill to be financing such a system.
sentences.zh: 你需要很多像替阿曼达付清账单的那种匿名捐赠者来资助这样一个系统。

sentences.en: So you'd need to have a big shift in kind of who's paying for health care.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要对谁来支付医疗费用进行一次大的转变。

sentences.en: There is going to be a lot of debate around Medicare for all and single payer in the next year.
sentences.zh: 明年围绕“全民医保”和“单一支付方”将会有很多辩论。

sentences.en: There are a lot of pluses and minuses to that type of system.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的系统有很多优点和缺点。

sentences.en: But what I can certainly say is that if the United States adopted a system like that, I would not have stories like Amanda's to write anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我可以肯定地说，如果美国采用了这样的系统，我就不会再有像阿曼达这样的故事可以写了。

sentences.en: Sarah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: They didn't want to do a ceasefire, but now they do want to do a ceasefire, I believe.
sentences.zh: 他们之前不想停火，但我相信他们现在想停火了。

sentences.en: It'll probably work out that way.
sentences.zh: 事情可能会那样发展。

sentences.en: During an unannounced trip to Afghanistan, President Trump said that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在一次未事先宣布的阿富汗之行中，特朗普总统表示，美国

sentences.en: would reopen peace talks with the Taliban, aimed at ending the 18-year-old war there.
sentences.zh: 将重启与塔利班的和平谈判，旨在结束那里长达18年的战争。

sentences.en: Trump had abruptly ended the talks in September after the Taliban claimed responsibility for a suicide bombing that killed a U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾在9月份突然终止了谈判，此前塔利班声称对一起导致一名美国

sentences.en: soldier.
sentences.zh: 士兵死亡的自杀式爆炸袭击负责。

sentences.en: The Taliban wants to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 塔利班想要达成协议。

sentences.en: We'll see if they make a deal.
sentences.zh: 我们会看看他们是否会达成协议。

sentences.en: If they do, they do.
sentences.zh: 如果他们达成，那就达成了。

sentences.en: And if they don't, they don't.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不达成，那就不达成。

sentences.en: But the president has now injected confusion into the negotiations by demanding a ceasefire from the Taliban, something U.S.
sentences.zh: 但总统现在通过要求塔利班停火，给谈判注入了混乱，这是美国

sentences.en: diplomats have never before saw, are unlikely to obtain, and have little power to enforce.
sentences.zh: 外交官们从未见过、不太可能实现且几乎无力强制执行的事情。

sentences.en: And in a letter, the House Judiciary Committee has given President Trump a deadline of this Friday
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，众议院司法委员会给了特朗普总统本周五的最后期限，

sentences.en: to decide whether to present a defense or call a witness as the committee considers articles of impeachment against him.
sentences.zh: 要求他决定在委员会审议针对他的弹劾条款时，是否要进行辩护或传唤证人。

sentences.en: The letter lays out a rapid timetable for impeachment in the House.
sentences.zh: 这封信为众议院的弹劾制定了一个快速的时间表。

sentences.en: The Judiciary Committee could vote on articles of impeachment by the week of December 9th.
sentences.zh: 司法委员会可能会在12月9日那一周对弹劾条款进行投票。

sentences.en: And the full House could vote on impeachment by the week of December 16th.
sentences.zh: 而众议院全体会议可能会在12月16日那一周对弹劾进行投票。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
